description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating runtime camera permission handling, including permission requests, rationale display, and starting CameraPreviewActivity upon permission grant.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An activity that manages runtime camera permission requests and launches camera preview.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and registers button click listener.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission request, starts camera if granted.

methods.name: showCameraPreview
methods.description: Checks camera permission and either starts preview or requests permission.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests camera permission, showing rationale if needed.
